meta.title: Vendor Clone: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and verify Vendor Clone is refused or absent, then repeat as a Procurement Manager and verify the action is available in the same Growth tenant.
Verify or record whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants Vendor Clone to additional roles.
Execute the Vendor Clone action for the Procurement Manager and observe its result.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and verify Vendor Clone is refused or absent, then repeat as a Procurement Manager and verify the action is available in the same Growth tenant.; Verify or record whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants Vendor Clone to additional roles.; Execute the Vendor Clone action for the Procurement Manager and observe its result.

steps.note: Open an existing active event so the project actions menu can be inspected.

args.need: sign in as a non-Procurement Manager and a Procurement Manager in the same Growth tenant, compare whether Vendor Clone is absent or refused for the first user and available for the second, and report the tenant RBAC configuration and clone results

steps.note: The catalog cannot change user identities, validate role-specific permissions, or perform the Vendor Clone workflow.
Inspect the closest catalog representation of Vendor Clone after the tester's role comparison; this does not independently prove the role-based requirement.
